# cayley-dickson-terrace-frontier (`0TH-2026-019`)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization, Rust/ISO C11/Python differential verifiers, interactive 3D WebGL observatory, and 17-page AMS-LaTeX white paper proving the Dyadic-Palindromic Terrace Law, Nilpotent Mirror Conservation, Dimension-64 Hurwitz–Radon Bott Rupture, and Sedenion Triple-42 Duality across generalized Cayley–Dickson algebras.

## Canonical Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quickstart commands, and verbatim 30-declaration Lean 4.35.0 `#print axioms` audit.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete theorem-by-theorem ledger (`T1a`–`T4d`, `C1`–`C2`) with `[LEAN-6K]` / `[EXACT-COMP]` tags.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit epistemic boundaries and open problems not claimed solved.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Step-by-step clean-clone reproduction commands.
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Machine-readable Lean 4.35.0 proof metadata & 6-kernel manifest.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Statement-only abbreviations `T1aStmt`–`T4dStmt` and `AllTerraceTheoremsStmt`.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Proof architecture, C-primitive kernel optimization, and tri-language differential design.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Palomar Comparator statement-to-paper fidelity mapping.
- [dist/Donahue_2026_cayley_dickson_terrace_frontier.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_cayley_dickson_terrace_frontier.pdf): Frozen 17-page AMS-LaTeX white paper.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Consolidated context bundle generated by `scripts/generate_manifests.py`.
